purpose: Test the first physically admissible saturation transition under atmospheric supply by composing the Ross soil-water column with a separate transactional surface-storage component and a flux-to-head boundary switch. This is an onset-of-ponding gate, not finite ponding/runoff qualification.

surface_boundary_contract.flux_branch: Allowed only when committed surface storage is zero and h_surface_required <= 1e-6 cm. Soil top flux is prescribed q_supply and surface storage remains zero.
surface_boundary_contract.ponding_onset_branch: When the flux branch is inadmissible, set hydraulic surface head to exactly 0 cm for this restricted onset gate. Soil infiltration q_top is solved from the same 10 cm hydraulic face used by the qualified face machinery. Excess supply is stored externally as S_surface_new = S_surface_old + dt*(q_supply-q_top).
surface_boundary_contract.surface_storage_owner: separate boundary/runtime component, not Ross soil persistent state
surface_boundary_contract.maximum_surface_storage_basis: one tenth of the unchanged E3 head-error threshold; larger storage requires a separate finite-ponding-head qualification

transaction_contract.rejected_trial_effect: bitwise no change to committed soil heads and exactly no change to committed surface-storage ledger
transaction_contract.commit: soil heads and surface storage commit atomically

hard_nonclaims: No finite positive ponding-head hydraulic feedback is qualified; h_surface is fixed at 0 cm in the onset branch.
No runoff, evaporation, rainfall interception or macropore surface routing is qualified.
No production nonlinear solver is qualified.
No endpoint-limit response tangent, heterogeneous profile, groundwater, runtime or MultiSWAP admission follows.
The legacy global/module implementation is not copied into the SWAP5 kernel.
hard_guards: The rejected flux-only E3D fixture remains negative evidence and is not overwritten.
No threshold, forcing, step count or face accuracy criterion may be tuned after this precommit.
Surface storage is a separate compositional state category and may not be hidden inside Ross soil state.
Mass conservation is hard across atmosphere plus surface plus soil.
If surface storage exceeds 0.025 cm, fail closed to a future finite-ponding gate rather than silently using h_surface=0.
